title: Finned Striders
body:
This resourcepack adds a fin to the backs of baby striders\ Also featuring a simple swimming animation :D\
[Credit goes to Konci for this post which the idea originates from](https://x.com/KonciTheLock/status/2009950584946995710)\
**Entity Model Features required!**\ **Tiny Takeover Backport required for 1.21.1!**\

![An adult strider and several baby ones, swimming in lava](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21a79d3edc727bb92a2990ab0321021436bb0cfa.png)
